note: Boxing and kickboxing technique trees, expanded from the 18-node template. Kickboxing deliberately carries NO hand-strike nodes: its hands ARE boxing's hands, cross-referenced by id per section 9 of TECHNIQUE_CATALOGUE_CONTRACT.md.

new_field.shared_with: NEW. A technique taught by several disciplines is owned by none of them. `shared_with` lists the other disciplines whose trees it also belongs to, so a kickboxer is not gated behind training BOXING to learn his own jab.
new_field.rulesets: NEW. Kickboxing is not one sport. K-1, Glory and Dutch allow low kicks and clinch knees; American Full Contact bans both. A technique scored under a ruleset that forbids it is a correctness bug.
